assign.outcome:
**Swap is a mechanism; tabs is one way to draw it — and every stage now has edges you can point at before you click.**

**The rule, written down.** *A click changes what is inside a rectangle you could already see; the rectangle stays.* It is the design rule of the realm now, in [doc/decisions.md](/imagine/paging/doc/decisions/), and it is enforced in CSS: any page whose mechanism is `swap` frames what its box holds (`.paging-box:has(.paging-items-swap) .paging-shown` — a surface, a 1px edge, an 8em floor; a tint step instead on `card`, because a white box on a white card has no edge).

**Tabs that show their panel.** Four classes in `paging.css` — `.paging-tabs .paging-tab-bar .paging-tab .paging-tab-panel`. The selected tab wears the panel's surface and paints its bottom border in the panel's colour instead of in the rule, so there is no line between them; the strip's remaining borders ARE the panel's top edge. Used in three places: the hub's miniature, the `tabs` visual, and a made page's tabs. `ext/tabs` was NOT touched — its selected tab is (0,4,0) in the same layer, so the site-wide version is a proposal with the full diff: [ext-tabs-proposal.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-05/paging-mechanisms-v2/ext-tabs-proposal.md).

**Four swap visuals, one stage** — [mechanisms/swap/](/imagine/paging/mechanisms/swap/): **tabs · card-in · cross-fade · flip**, with a caption that names the panel that arrived and measures the stage before and after. The stage has a fixed height on purpose, so the claim is a measurement. Driven headless at 1920: `[1428, 792, 446, 174]` identical before and after every swap in `tabs` and `cross-fade`; `flip` turned on the same rectangle. Motion is 180–240ms and `prefers-reduced-motion` cuts it to 1ms.

![the four visuals at 1280](shots/swap-four-visuals-1280.png)

**The mechanisms on the site's real columns, with honest routing.** Each page says what a click does and whether the url changes, in its first sentence: [launch](/imagine/paging/mechanisms/launch/) opens real child columns **three levels deep** (proved: `/launch/` → `/alpha/` → `/alpha-deeper/` → `/alpha-deepest/`, url changed each time, columns 5→8) · [expand](/imagine/paging/mechanisms/expand/) never routes (url unchanged, the row 133px → 253px) · [swap](/imagine/paging/mechanisms/swap/) never routes · [takeover](/imagine/paging/mechanisms/takeover/) routes, with the exit chip.

**Tabs UX on made pages** — [Make](/imagine/paging/make/). A tab is a child page drawn as a tab: one word on the parent (`"kids": "tabs"`, beside the three it already had) switches its children between columns and tabs, and the row grows `+ tab`, rename-in-place, and up/down reorder. Proved on disk: `made/notes/page.json` took `"kids": "tabs"` and `children: [later, today, new-tab]`; the made page rendered three tabs whose panel rect did not move and whose url did not change. `make/tabs.js` owns no storage — every control goes through `Make.apply()`, the persistence judge's one write seam.

![the tabs UX on Make](shots/make-tabs-ux-1920.png)

**Every hub link lands where its sentence says.** 31 crawled. One was wrong and is fixed: all four miniatures read *"The real X, at full size"*, true only of `takeover` — each now says what its page actually does. And `/imagine/paging/doc/` had no `page.js` and 404'd, so the records beside it were reachable only by a raw `.md` url; it is a [Docs index](/imagine/paging/doc/) now, `route()`-based so four markdown records do not become four console 404s.

**Checked:** zero console errors, zero 4xx, no horizontal overflow — 9 pages × 400/1280/1920/3440.

**Left open, with reasons.** (1) `ext/tabs` and `core/` are outside the fence, so the site-wide tab panel is a proposal, not a commit. (2) Every `readme/` route on the site logs a 404 for `readme/page.js` before falling back to markdown (`/framework/ext/tabs/readme/`, `/imagine/mag/readme/` too) — core's probe order, a proposal. (3) `/imagine/research.md` and `/imagine/research/research-front.css` 404ed on every `/imagine/` page for a few minutes mid-run — another minion writing under `/imagine/research/`; both cleared, worth a re-check before the commit.
